120h.labels: artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/model_labels_v4_120h, built with configs/sensor_failure_model_v4_120h.json (development months only; same exclusions and Q shadow as v2)
120h.issue: rolling list: every day new cards for object x sensor type pairs without an open card, no displacement, a card stays open 5 days

secondary_horizons.role: models on the horizon's own label for the best 24 h candidate and F2+all (c3, seeds 17/18/19); 120 h at most 5 open is a secondary criterion, 120 h at most 3 open and 72 h (at most 6 and 3 open) are reported only; the primary criterion stays 24 h, 2 cards per day

one_model: a single CatBoost model per target x horizon for all sensor types; sensor and system types are features (cat__), as in v2/v3
fold_note: as v2/v3; calibration (2025 H1) and holdout (2025-07..2026-06) are not read; no final stage
fit_rows: as v2/v3: candidate rows with a known label, all positives plus the deterministic 10% hash sample of negatives, weighted 10 before Balanced weighting

N.point_in_time: monthly snapshot: the graph of each month uses only member starts before the first day of the month; a channel outside every group is its own node
N.history: the node's history is the union of its channels' history (an event counts for the node at the first start of a member on the node)

E.intervals: last 10 inter-event intervals: median, CV, expected next = last + median, due within 1 day
E.hawkes_source: candidate timestamps of the label in hourly buckets, object x sensor type and object

holidays.source: Labour Code of the Russian Federation, art. 112 part 1 (non-working holidays: 1-6 and 8 January New Year holidays, 7 January, 23 February, 8 March, 1 May, 9 May, 12 June, 4 November)
holidays.not_applied: weekend transfers set by annual government decrees (e.g. a holiday on a weekend moved to a weekday) are not in the repository and are not applied

K.not_repeated: weekday, weekend and month are cal__ columns of F2

S.area: level-2 parent of the object in the current object reference (1 / 16 / 78 hierarchy, no validity dates)

units: object x sensor type (prior: sensor type)
T.events: target events known to qualify before t (static-list rule)

W.idea: I2 traces of power and works (reports/sensor-failure-v4-i2-precursors-2026-09-26.json)
W.window: [t - 24 h, t), records of the object's other channels, journal working_events (texts as artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/ideas/i2/i2.py)

signals.pumpfan_deenergized: 'Обесточен' of 'Состояние насоса' / 'Состояние вентилятора': flag and count
signals.deenergized: 'Обесточен' of any sensor type: flag and count
signals.switched_off_device: 'Выключен' of devices other than 'Переключатель', pumps and fans: flag

W.not_used: door, motion and 'КД АВ' records over the past day (ratio to control about 1.0 in I2)

branch_B_not_here: object rhythm (same weekday 7/14 d ago, recency of the object's last event, session days, weekday/working-hour profile, periodicity) belongs to branch B and enters v4 as a separate ablation when delivered

c3.use: every feature set (best mean in CV v3)

node_combination.unit_N: card = node (a channel without a node is its own node); the event stays the mass cluster; node -> event by channel overlap; ceiling, persistence and static list of unit N on the same folds

hygiene.thread_count: fixed 6; cv.json records thread_count, os.cpu_count() and the CPU model
hygiene.paired_by_seed: for a candidate and the baseline of the same configuration, the difference is taken per seed (same seed, same fit rows) and per fold
hygiene.tie_rule: a candidate ties with the baseline unless the mean paired difference (over seeds and folds) exceeds the spread (max - min over seeds) of the fold-mean paired differences; ties go to the baseline
hygiene.seed_ensemble: bootstrap intervals use the mean of the three seeds' card scores

criteria.primary: unit A, 24 h, 2 cards per day: paired-by-seed difference of card precision (candidate - F2, same configuration) > 0 on both folds (seed means), AND its mean over seeds and folds > its seed spread (not a tie), AND candidate event recall >= persistence recall - 0.02
criteria.secondary: 72 h rolling lists (at most 6 and 3 open) and 120 h at most 3 open: reported only (models vs persistence, static list and ceiling)
criteria.references: persistence and the static list of last year at the same budget; ceilings reported
criteria.T_proxy_check: F2+T is flagged as an object proxy if its week-block CI of the precision difference is above zero but the object-block CI is not; T passes only without the flag
criteria.node_combination: a combination passes if its paired difference to model_only (same feature set, configuration and seed) satisfies the primary rule; unit N is reported beside unit A against its own ceiling, persistence and static list, the product unit is chosen by the technologist and the user
criteria.weekly_ci: 95% week-block bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 17) on the pooled evaluation years with bootstrap_variant_deltas, seed ensemble; object blocks reported
criteria.failure: a group that does not pass is not used; the result is reported as is
criteria.best_candidate: among feature sets passing the primary criterion (c3), the one with the largest mean paired difference; if none passes, the best candidate is F2 itself

secondary_120h.models: the best 24 h candidate and F2+all (c3, seed ensemble = mean of the three seeds' card scores)
secondary_120h.rule: card precision of the model above the static list of last year: week-block paired bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 17) 95% lower bound of the difference > 0 on the pooled evaluation years 2023-2024; AND event recall of the model >= static-list recall - 0.02
secondary_120h.reported: object-block CI of the same difference; persistence and ceiling; per-fold and per-seed values

runner: data-science/scripts/tune_sensor_failure_v4.py: stage describe (no fitting), stage cv (lanes run as parallel processes, 6 CatBoost threads each), stage report

describe_findings.unit_N: before any model, unit N at 2 cards per day is below unit A: persistence P 0.048 / R 0.034 and static list 0.095 / 0.067 vs unit A 0.116 / 0.115 and 0.126 / 0.137 (object x type cards cover many channels); N stays a reported unit, not a gate
describe_findings.node_propagation: for persistence with the max card aggregation, propagating the node max changes nothing (nodes lie inside one object and mostly one type); it can only matter for model scores aggregated by mean_top2

time_budget: 24 h: c3 9 feature sets x 3 seeds x 2 folds = 54 fits (about 90-145 s each), c1 2 x 3 x 2 = 12 fits (about 35-60 s); secondary 72 h and 120 h: 2 sets x 3 seeds x 2 folds each = 24 fits: about 3.5 hours; node combinations need no extra fits
